description: Property stays lww across an add_prop epoch boundary (no change_crdt). Epochs 1 and 2 resolve the property to the same CRDT, so both epochs' ops pool into ONE lww total order (SCHEMA.md §4.1 segment rule). The newest op (a1 @90) lives in the EARLIER epoch yet still wins: per-epoch partitioning would wrongly reseed at the epoch-2 order key and let a2 (@60) win — the falsification target.
